# Dave's Maine Cafe

> A tiny, owner-operated cafe on Route 1 in Kittery, Maine, known for fresh-picked lobster rolls, comfort food, bourbon, and dry roadside humor.

Canonical site: https://www.davesmainecafe.com/

Core facts:
- Address: 439 US Route 1, Ste 1, Kittery, ME 03904.
- Phone: +1-207-475-5655.
- Open Wednesday-Friday 11:30 AM-7 PM and Saturday-Sunday 11:30 AM-5 PM; closed Monday-Tuesday.
- Dave's Lobster Roll is $20 on regular open days and $18 every Thursday, with limited daily supply.
- The lobster is fresh, hand-picked, and never frozen.
